notes.title: Mineko's Night Market Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who has played the game so far. We can hardly believe it’s finally out in the world after all this time. We hope you are enjoying exploring Mt Fugu Island and all its mysteries! 

On to the announcement!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/mineko-plush][img]https://i.ibb.co/z7bHRrM/Mineko-Plush-1920x1080.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]MINEKO PLUSH[/h2]

We’re SO excited to be partnering with our friends at [url=https://www.makeship.com/]Makeship[/url] to bring you this limited edition plush of our main girl, Mineko! The campaign is running for 16 more days and we’ll need to hit at least 200 pre-orders to put her into production. If sweet, huggable plushies are your jam, please check out the campaign [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/mineko-plush]here[/url]. 


[h2]GAME UPDATES[/h2]

We’re working super hard to bring you frequent updates and bug fixes. You can check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/762940/discussions/0/3882722559229636527/]technical thread[/url] over on our discussion page to see our changes/fixes. If you have a bug to report, please use our [url=https://forms.gle/P4gyhS67Mmj9A7ok8]bug reporting form[/url] to make sure we have all the information possible in order to fix it.

[h2]OTHER NEWS[/h2]

We’ve also started a [url=https://discord.com/invite/uzJpUneV72]discord channel[/url] where you can share your suggestions, chat about the game, or share some photos of your awesome cat! Join us!

That’s it for now, friends! 

Meowza Games

notes.title: Build V0.8.0.10 Changelog (PC/OSX)
notes.content: Hot fix for an issue where some players were getting stuck in a state where their main quests weren’t advancing after a certain point. If you’ve cleared The Docks, Dark Forest, and The Caves and have a bug where you haven’t seen a particular cutscene at the bus stop that involves the Artifacts and Bobo, take the bus to any location. Upon your return, this cutscene should re-trigger and advance your main quests again.

notes.title: Mineko’s Night Market Summer Update
notes.content:
Hello! Happy Season of the Burning Sun! We’ve been working on a LOT of new features in the last few months that we’d like to reveal to you here TODAY. So, come along and see what’s new! [img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/i6wed0mr6wsqgc9/Mineko_DevLog_Intro.jpg[/img]
[h1]Costumes[/h1]
Mineko can now craft COSTUMES! Certain areas will only be accessible when wearing a disguise (secret hideouts!), wearing protective gear (treacherous terrain!), or trendy clothing (anywhere teens hang out)![img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/rqtzmgvpra69kxg/MinekosNightMarket_Costume.png[/img]
[h1]Locations Locations Locations[/h1]We’ve been fleshing out the island of Mt. Fugu with art for new locations to explore, new resources to discover, and new friends to befriend (if you’re nice)![img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/kn9hi6bs4vgo1r4/Mineko_Locations.png[/img]
[h1]Crafting[/h1] All crafts will involve minigames, so we’ve been busy designing and experimenting with a bunch of new workbench minigame concepts! Work it! Work it! [img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/aw6v0ndqsq278dr/Mineko_Crafting.jpg[/img]
[h1]Resources[/h1]
We’ve been adding (and still adding!) and tweaking (and tweaking further!) interactions for the various resource gathering interactions like mining, firefly catching, and snow monkey grooming (what?!)![img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/fa78fe379ax9jow/Mineko_DevLog_Resources.jpg[/img]
[h1]Quests[/h1]We have been busy working and reworking (and reworking) the Quest system. It’s important for us to not allow the story to interrupt the player’s pace while still offering an engaging direction. We think (hope) we are close to this goal![img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/sfxql8njy7gfnhc/Mineko_Artifact.jpg[/img]
[h1]Night Market Main Events[/h1]Oh! And I guess a game with “Night Market” in the title should have a Night Market. The Night Market will feature 16 unique weekly Main Events, like Cat Racing, Tea Ceremonies, and Sumo-Suit Wrestling![img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/3rb12i86gesi5fs/Mineko_Sumo.jpg[/img]
[h1]Thank you[/h1]We’re truly grateful for all your patience and kindness while we continue to develop the game. We are so excited for you to play it!
